assertions.title: Single layout style as primary
assertions.evidence: Closure-based layout functions (horizontal(Fn), vertical(Fn)) have been removed. Only begin/end style remains: begin_row()/end_row(), begin_column()/end_column(), begin_grid()/end_grid(). Layout module doc comment documents begin/end as primary: 'begin_row/end_row, begin_column/end_column, begin_grid/end_grid'. All call sites in tests use begin/end style.

assertions.title: Font bytes stored without Box::leak
assertions.evidence: Zero instances of Box::leak found in katla_ui/src/text/. FontSystem struct (text/mod.rs line 183) stores fonts as HashMap<FontId, FontArc> with comment 'Loaded fonts stored with owned data (no Box::leak)'. No Vec<Vec<u8>> either — uses FontArc (reference-counted font handle from fontdb crate) which is the idiomatic approach. All 62 katla_ui tests pass including font/glyph-related tests.

assertions.title: Cursor advancement is consistent
assertions.evidence: UiContext::add() (context/mod.rs line 205) unconditionally calls self.advance_cursor() with the widget's response bounds after widget.ui() executes. This means every widget drawn through ui.add() advances the cursor. The advance_cursor method (layout.rs line 100) handles both direct cursor and layout-stack cursor positioning. Dedicated tests confirm: test_add_advances_cursor, test_add_advances_cursor_in_row_layout, test_add_advances_cursor_in_column_layout, test_add_stacks_widgets_vertically, test_at_cursor_positions_and_advances, test_label_advances_cursor_via_add.

advance_cursor handles layout stack and direct cursor, respects layout direction (horizontal/vertical)
62 tests pass including 6 cursor-specific advancement tests

assertions.title: Border color handled in button_with_colors
assertions.evidence: Border drawing logic is centralized entirely in UiContext::button_with_colors() (context/widgets/basic.rs line 17). The method accepts border_color: Option<Color> and draws border via self.draw_selection_border(bounds, border_color, 1.0) at line ~60. Button::ui() (widgets/mod.rs line 149) delegates to button_with_colors, passing through self.border_color. No border drawing code exists in the Button builder Widget::ui() impl — it only forwards parameters. Dedicated tests confirm: test_button_border_drawn_in_button_with_colors and test_button_border_forwarded_to_internal_method both pass.
